title: Purpose & Calling
intro: Nobody knows yet who this child will be, and that is the point. This month resists the temptation to decide it for them. It asks instead that their life would count, that they would be useful and glad, and that we would have the grace to raise a person rather than a plan.

keyScriptures.text: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.
I know the plans I have for you, plans to prosper you and not to harm you.

weeks.title: There Is a Reason You Are Here
weeks.declaration: Your life has a point, and it did not have to be earned. There is good work with your name on it already.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, thank You that this child's life has a purpose we did not have to invent. Amen.

weeks.title: Not Our Plan for You
weeks.declaration: You are not here to complete anyone else's plan. What you are for is between you and God, and we will help you find it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, keep us from making this child carry our ambitions. Give us open hands. Amen.

weeks.title: Useful and Glad
weeks.declaration: May you be useful, and may you be glad while you are. Those two belong together, and a life with only one of them is a thin thing.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, let this child love what they end up doing. Let their work be good for them and for others. Amen.

weeks.title: Growing Is the Work
weeks.declaration: Growing is your whole calling this year. It is enough, and you are doing it well.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, help us be content with who this child is today rather than who they might become. Amen.

days.title: A Reason You Are Here
days.declaration: Your life has a point. It did not have to be earned and it cannot be lost.

scripture.text: We are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works.

days.title: Plans Already Made
days.declaration: There are plans for you, and they are good ones. You are not walking into nothing.

scripture.text: I know the plans I have for you.

days.title: Not Our Plan
days.declaration: You are not here to finish anyone else's story. Yours is your own.

scripture.text: All the days ordained for me were written in your book.

days.title: Growing Is Your Work
days.declaration: Growing is your whole job this year, and it is a real one.

scripture.text: The child grew and became strong.

days.title: Made With Care
days.declaration: Whatever you end up doing, you were assembled carefully for it.

scripture.text: You knit me together in my mother's womb.

days.title: Useful and Glad
days.declaration: May you be useful, and glad while you are. Those two belong together.

scripture.text: There is nothing better for a person than to enjoy their work.

days.title: Needed Somewhere
days.declaration: There is somewhere that will need exactly you. It is already waiting.

scripture.text: God has placed the parts in the body just as he wanted them.

days.title: Not Too Young to Matter
days.declaration: You matter now, not once you are useful. Your value is not deferred.

scripture.text: See that you do not despise one of these little ones.

days.title: Called Before Able
days.declaration: God calls people long before they are able. Ability comes after the calling, not before.

scripture.text: Go in the strength you have.

days.title: Gifts Already In You
days.declaration: Whatever you are good at is already in you, waiting to be discovered rather than installed.

scripture.text: We have different gifts, according to the grace given to each of us.

days.title: Your Own Pace
days.declaration: You will do everything at the time it is right for you. There is no race.

scripture.text: He has made everything beautiful in its time.

days.title: Character First
days.declaration: Who you become will matter more than what you do. God builds the person first.

scripture.text: The Lord looks at the heart.

days.title: Placed in This Time
days.declaration: You were born now rather than a century ago, and that was chosen.

scripture.text: He marked out their appointed times in history.

days.title: Small Things First
days.declaration: You will start with small things. Everything significant is built out of them.

scripture.text: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much.

days.title: Willing Hands
days.declaration: May you grow up willing. Willingness opens more doors than talent.

scripture.text: Here am I. Send me!

days.title: Not a Job Title
days.declaration: Your purpose is bigger than whatever job you end up with. It is about how you live.

scripture.text: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart.

days.title: Free to Change Course
days.declaration: You will be allowed to change your mind, more than once. Redirection is not failure.

scripture.text: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

days.title: Made to Give
days.declaration: You were made to give something away, not only to receive. That will make you happy.

scripture.text: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

days.title: A Life That Counts
days.declaration: Your life will count. It counts already, before you have done a single thing.

scripture.text: You have crowned them with glory and honour.

days.title: Learning Is Preparation
days.declaration: Everything you are learning now is preparation for something. None of it is wasted.

scripture.text: Start children off on the way they should go.

days.title: Not Behind
days.declaration: You will never be behind. There is no schedule you can fail to keep.

scripture.text: My times are in your hands.

days.title: Purpose Is Not Pressure
days.declaration: Having a calling is a gift, not a weight. May you never feel crushed by it.

scripture.text: My yoke is easy and my burden is light.

days.title: Ordinary Days Count
days.declaration: Most of your purpose will happen on ordinary days with people you already know.

scripture.text: Make it your ambition to lead a quiet life.

days.title: Something Only You
days.declaration: There will be things only you are placed to do. Nobody can take your part.

scripture.text: Who knows but that you have come to your position for such a time as this?

days.title: Serving Comes Naturally
days.declaration: May serving people be normal to you rather than a sacrifice you have to make.

scripture.text: Serve one another humbly in love.

days.title: Held Through the Finding
days.declaration: It may take years to find. You will be held for all of them.

scripture.text: I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand.

days.title: Not Measured Against Siblings
days.declaration: You will not be compared to anyone in this family. Your calling is not a competition.

scripture.text: Each one should test their own actions.

days.title: Faithful Rather Than Famous
days.declaration: May you be faithful. Whether anyone notices is God's business, not yours.

scripture.text: Those who have been given a trust must prove faithful.

days.title: Started, Not Finished
days.declaration: God has started something in you and does not abandon what He starts.

scripture.text: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

days.title: Ours to Pray For
days.declaration: We will pray this over you for years before you understand it. It will be here waiting.

scripture.text: We continually ask God to fill you with the knowledge of his will.

days.title: Yours to Discover
days.declaration: This is yours to discover, not ours to assign. We will be glad whatever it turns out to be.

scripture.text: In all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.
